name: prompt
doc: A persistent key hint: "[E] Open garage". Superset of ox showTextUI, qb DrawText and esx_textui. Drawn by `key-prompt` in a stack per position. Stays until cancelled; with `hold` it resolves true when the hold fills (the caller's Lua feeds `progress`, the page has no keyboard focus).

label.doc: ox `text`. A leading [E] is lifted into `keys` by the Lua API.

hold.doc: ms the key must be held. The caller updates `progress` (0–1) from the game, or the page reads the key when it has focus.

active.doc: The one the key acts on now, among several prompts.

style.doc: Inline CSS (camelCase). Escape hatch for adapters.

confirm.doc: Pressed or held (only when the page reads keys).
